C     THIS SUBROUTINE SIMPLY SET THE GLOBAL PS CONFIGURATION GLOBAL
C      VARIABLES FROM A GIVEN VARIABLE IN DOUBLE PRECISION
      SUBROUTINE ML5_0_SET_MP_PS(P)

      INTEGER    NEXTERNAL
      PARAMETER (NEXTERNAL=5)
      REAL*16 MP_PS(0:3,NEXTERNAL),MP_P(0:3,NEXTERNAL)
      COMMON/ML5_0_MP_PSPOINT/MP_PS,MP_P
      REAL*8 P(0:3,NEXTERNAL)
      LOGICAL KEEP_OFFSHELL_MASS(NEXTERNAL)

      KEEP_OFFSHELL_MASS(1) = .FALSE.
      KEEP_OFFSHELL_MASS(2) = .FALSE.
      KEEP_OFFSHELL_MASS(3) = .FALSE.
      KEEP_OFFSHELL_MASS(4) = .FALSE.
      KEEP_OFFSHELL_MASS(5) = .FALSE.



      DO I=1,NEXTERNAL
        DO J=0,3
          MP_PS(J,I)=P(J,I)
        ENDDO
      ENDDO
      CALL ML5_0_MP_IMPROVE_PS_POINT_PRECISION(KEEP_OFFSHELL_MASS
     $ ,MP_PS)
      DO I=1,NEXTERNAL
        DO J=0,3
          MP_P(J,I)=MP_PS(J,I)
        ENDDO
      ENDDO

      END

C     BEGIN CODE
C     ----------

C     Decide whether to really compute the integrand in quadruple
C      precision or to fake it and copy the double precision
C      computation in the quadruple precision variables.
      COMPUTE_INTEGRAND_IN_QP = ((MLREDUCTIONLIB(LIBINDEX)
     $ .EQ.6.AND.USEQPINTEGRANDFORNINJA) .OR. (MLREDUCTIONLIB(LIBINDEX)
     $ .EQ.1.AND.USEQPINTEGRANDFORCUTTOOLS) .OR.
     $  (MLREDUCTIONLIB(LIBINDEX).EQ.8.AND.USEQPINTEGRANDFORNINJARS))

C     To be on the safe side, we always update the MP params here.
C     It can be redundant as this routine can be called a couple of
C      times for the same PS point during the stability checks.
C     But it is really not time consuming and I would rather be safe.
      CALL MP_UPDATE_AS_PARAM()

      MP_DONE_ONCE = .TRUE.

C     AS A SAFETY MEASURE WE FIRST COPY HERE THE PS POINT
      DO I=1,NEXTERNAL
        DO J=0,3
          MP_P(J,I)=PS(J,I)
          P(J,I) = REAL(PS(J,I),KIND=8)
        ENDDO
      ENDDO

      DO I=0,3
        PL(I,-1)=CMPLX(ZERO,ZERO,KIND=16)
        PL(I,0)=CMPLX(ZERO,ZERO,KIND=16)
        IF (.NOT.COMPUTE_INTEGRAND_IN_QP) THEN
          DP_PL(I,-1)=DCMPLX(0.0D0,0.0D0)
          DP_PL(I,0)=DCMPLX(0.0D0,0.0D0)
        ENDIF
      ENDDO

      DO I=1,MAXLWFSIZE
        DO J=0,LOOPMAXCOEFS-1
          DO K=1,MAXLWFSIZE
            WL(I,J,K,-1)=(ZERO,ZERO)
            DP_WL(I,J,K,-1)=(0.0D0,0.0D0)
            IF (I.EQ.K.AND.J.EQ.0) THEN
              WL(I,J,K,0)=(1.0E0_16,ZERO)
            ELSE
              WL(I,J,K,0)=(ZERO,ZERO)
            ENDIF
            IF (.NOT.COMPUTE_INTEGRAND_IN_QP) THEN
              IF (I.EQ.K.AND.J.EQ.0) THEN
                DP_WL(I,J,K,0)=(1.0D0,0.0D0)
              ELSE
                DP_WL(I,J,K,0)=(0.0D0,0.0D0)
              ENDIF
            ENDIF
          ENDDO
        ENDDO
      ENDDO

W(I)%P = DPW(I)%P
              W(I)%FLV_INDEX = DPW(I)%FLV_INDEX
            ENDDO
          ENDIF

 3000     CONTINUE
          MP_UVCT_REQ_SO_DONE=.TRUE.

          IF (COMPUTE_INTEGRAND_IN_QP) THEN

            DO J=1,NBORNAMPS
              CTEMP = HEL_MULT*2.0E0_16*CONJG(AMP(J))
              DO I=1,NCTAMPS
                CFTOT=CMPLX(CF_N(I,J)/REAL(ABS(CF_D(I,J)),KIND=16)
     $           ,0.0E0_16,KIND=16)
                IF(CF_D(I,J).LT.0) CFTOT=CFTOT*IMAG1
                ITEMP =
     $            ML5_0_ML5SQSOINDEX(ML5_0_ML5SOINDEX_FOR_LOOP_AMP(I)
     $           ,ML5_0_ML5SOINDEX_FOR_BORN_AMP(J))
                IF (.NOT.FILTER_SO.OR.SQSO_TARGET.EQ.ITEMP) THEN
                  DO K=1,3

DO J=1,NLOOPLINE
        DO I=0,3
          P_NRS(I,J)=P_TMP(I,J-1)
          P_S_MAT(J,I)=P_NRS(I,J)
        ENDDO
      ENDDO
C     Use MadLoop's thresholded invariants, including complex on-shell
C      masses.
      CALL ML5_0_MP_BUILD_KINEMATIC_MATRIX(NLOOPLINE,P_S_MAT,MASSES
     $ ,S_MAT)
      DO J=1,NLOOPLINE
        DO I=1,NLOOPLINE
          REAL_S_MAT(I,J)=REAL(S_MAT(I,J)+MASSES(I)+MASSES(J)
     $     ,KIND=KI_QNRS)
        ENDDO
      ENDDO
      CURR_MAXCOEF=NCOEF_R(RANK)
      DO I=0,CURR_MAXCOEF-1
        TENSORCOEFS(I)=LOOPCOEFS(I,SQSOINDEX,ID)
C       q_loop -> -q_loop in NinjaRS's denominator convention.
        IF (MOD(COEFTORANK_MAP(I),2).EQ.1) TENSORCOEFS(I)=
     $   -TENSORCOEFS(I)
      ENDDO
      NRS_SCALE=REAL(MU_R**2,KIND=KI_QNRS)
      CALL NINJARS_TENSOR_EVALUATE(TENSORCOEFS(0:CURR_MAXCOEF-1)
     $ ,NLOOPLINE,RANK,REAL_S_MAT,P_NRS,MASSES,NRS_SCALE,NRS_RES,R1
     $ ,NRS_STATUS)
      STABLE=NRS_STATUS.EQ.NINJARS_SUCCESS
